name: Adverse media or intelligence linking counterparties to criminal activity
description: Counterparties, suppliers, respondents or controllers appear in adverse media, law-enforcement notices or intelligence connected to financial crime, abuse, forced labour or organised crime.
fp: Adverse media can be inaccurate, dated or relate to a namesake; verify identity and credibility before acting.

links.name: Transactions with high-risk counterparties
links.ctx: Payments to or from parties linked to adverse media, sanctions or higher-risk sectors.

links.name: Adverse media or import bans related to supplier
links.ctx: Credible allegations or customs detentions connected with forced labour.

links.name: Adverse media or intelligence on trafficking network associations
links.ctx: Customer or counterparties named in credible reports or law enforcement requests relating to trafficking.

links.name: Adverse media or enforcement on respondent
links.ctx: Respondent has regulatory action, sanctions or ML scandals.

links.name: Links to known launderers or adverse media
links.ctx: Counterparties or controllers appear in law-enforcement notices, adverse media or intelligence.

links.name: Associates linked to known organised crime groups
links.ctx: Counterparties in adverse media or law enforcement intelligence.
